03253 Yicmakyahuw {yis-mak-yaw-hoo'}

源自 05564 和 03050; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Ismachiah 1; 1

伊斯瑪基雅 = "耶和華維繫"
1) 於希西家王復興時期負責督理祭祀供應的利未人之一 （#代下 31:13|）

from 05564 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Ismachiah 1; 1

Ismachiah = "Jehovah sustains"
1) a Levite and overseer of the offerings during the revival in the
   time of king Hezekiah
